levels.title: Try the tool in a few minutes
levels.description: Type your name, add two images and write a few words. Then download a demo PDF. There are no questions to solve and no other websites to open.

screenshots.title: Any image you choose
screenshots.help: Choose any non-private image from your device, or use the demo image button. There is no specific content to show.
screenshots.exampleDescription: An example of an image in this practice field. Any non-private image is fine; you are only trying the upload tool.

screenshots.title: Any image you choose
screenshots.help: Choose any non-private image from your device, or use the demo image button. There is no specific content to show.
screenshots.exampleDescription: An example of an image in this practice field. Any non-private image is fine; you are only trying the upload tool.

levels.title: Build your assistant
levels.description: Build your own internal customer-service Gem. Add the company policy, test five questions and verify each answer in the original policy.

screenshots.title: Your Gem instructions
screenshots.help: Show the part of your saved instructions about sources, missing information and human limits. Use a readable crop, not an entire desktop.

screenshots.title: Your policy source
screenshots.help: Show the Knowledge area with your company-policy file visible. Do not show a personal account menu.

questions.label: Service area
questions.question: Can the company send an order to Sweden, or is the service limited to mainland Finland?

questions.label: No order reference
questions.question: A caller has no OrderID. What information should I collect, and who should find the correct order?

questions.label: Estimated date
questions.question: The register gives an expected date but no time. May I promise arrival at 10:00 on that date?

questions.label: Refund request
questions.question: A customer demands compensation. Can this assistant approve a refund, and which human team handles refund decisions?

questions.label: Missing information
questions.question: An order-specific fact is missing from the sources. What should the assistant do instead of guessing?

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you check or improve?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What should the assistant not do?

levels.title: Build your FAQ
levels.description: Build five FAQ entries from the original emails and phone transcripts. Add your own FAQ to the same Gem, then test and verify five new questions.

screenshots.title: An FAQ entry and its original IDs
screenshots.help: Show one of your own FAQ entries: the rule, its important condition and the email/call IDs behind it.

screenshots.title: A tested FAQ answer
screenshots.help: Show your Gem question and answer for one of D2-Q01 to D2-Q05. Choose a crop that leaves the key condition readable.

questions.label: Address after dispatch
questions.question: My order is already In transit. Can you confirm a new delivery address just because it is in the same city?

questions.label: Invoice copy
questions.question: I lost the invoice. What details are needed for a duplicate, where is it sent, and does it create a new charge?

questions.label: Damaged delivery
questions.question: The box and item arrived damaged. What must I provide, by when, and should I return or throw away anything now?

questions.label: Missed delivery
questions.question: I missed delivery and the attempt-notice link does not work. Can the service desk promise a free redelivery on Friday?

questions.label: In transit
questions.question: Tracking says In transit with an estimated arrival tomorrow. Is it already on the local delivery route, and is before lunch guaranteed?

levels.improvementPrompt: How did you combine the conversations?

levels.title: Add changing information
levels.description: Add your order register and test five questions against the fixed original records. Then add ORD-TEST-01 and observe whether the updated source is used.

screenshots.title: Your added test-order row
screenshots.help: Show ORD-TEST-01 in your own register with its status, date and note. Preserve all 30 original rows.

screenshots.title: The actual update-test response
screenshots.help: Show your question about ORD-TEST-01 and what the Gem actually answered, including an unsuccessful result if that happened.

questions.label: Helsinki order
questions.question: For ORD-1042, give destination, status, expected date and latest update. Is the arrival date guaranteed?

questions.label: Recorded delivery
questions.question: Has ORD-1047 been recorded as delivered? Give the destination, last update and recorded delivery note.

questions.label: Order on hold
questions.question: Why is ORD-1053 on hold, and which team should deal with the issue?

questions.label: No arrival estimate
questions.question: What estimated arrival date is recorded for ORD-1058? Can you work one out from the order date?

questions.label: Compare two statuses
questions.question: Compare ORD-1042 and ORD-1065. Which is on the local delivery route, and is either recorded as Delivered?

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you add and test?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What does your update test show - and not show?

levels.title: Update and improve
levels.description: Find less-common knowledge, apply the approved management change and add the specified register field. Test the updates and one unchanged rule.

screenshots.title: Your new register field
screenshots.help: Show PreferredUpdateChannel and its five specified OrderIDs. Hide unrelated columns to make a wide, readable screenshot; do not change original order data.

screenshots.title: Your actual retest response
screenshots.help: Show D4-Q04 and the Gem response after your update. The reply may still be wrong if the new source was not read; report that honestly.

questions.label: One box missing
questions.question: An order contains two parcels but only one arrived. What references and details should I collect before reporting the missing part?

questions.label: Reception delivery
questions.question: The status is Delivered but the named customer has not received the parcel personally. What should they check, and what happens if it is still missing?

questions.label: New follow-up rule
questions.question: Under the new management decision, can a routine order-progress follow-up be by phone, and how should a recorded Phone preference be handled?

questions.label: New field in use
questions.question: After the register update, what is PreferredUpdateChannel for ORD-1053, and what should staff arrange under M01?

questions.label: Still mainland only
questions.question: After the updates, can the company now deliver an order to Sweden, or is the mainland-Finland service boundary unchanged?

levels.improvementPrompt: Which three source updates did you make?
levels.reflectionPrompt: Who should maintain these sources, and what remains uncertain?
